#Boosting sense balanceig
```{r}
# boosting SENSE BALANCEIG
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)

dades <- read.csv2("dades_imputades.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
dades$Balance               <- as.numeric(dades$Balance)
dades$AvgTransactionAmount  <- as.numeric(dades$AvgTransactionAmount)
dades$EstimatedSalary       <- as.numeric(dades$EstimatedSalary)

dades$Geography       <- factor(dades$Geography)
dades$Gender          <- factor(dades$Gender)
dades$CustomerSegment <- factor(dades$CustomerSegment)
dades$EducationLevel  <- factor(dades$EducationLevel)
dades$LoanStatus      <- factor(dades$LoanStatus)
dades$MaritalStatus   <- factor(dades$MaritalStatus)

df <- dades

# 1) Train / test
df_tr <- df %>% filter(Group == "train")
df_te <- df %>% filter(Group == "test")

# 2) Variables
vars_x <- c("Geography", "Balance", "Age",
            "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts",
            "NetPromoterScore", "Gender")

# 3) Target
df_tr$Exited <- factor(df_tr$Exited, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes"))

# 4) Dummies
dmy <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_tr[, vars_x], fullRank = TRUE)

X_tr <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_tr[, vars_x]))
X_te <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_te[, vars_x]))

train_boost <- cbind(Exited = df_tr$Exited, X_tr)
test_boost  <- X_te

# =====================================================
# ENTRENAMENT DEL MODEL (IGUAL QUE EL TEU)
# =====================================================
set.seed(1)

trControl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 3,
  classProbs = TRUE
)

xgb_model <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_boost,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = trControl,
  verbosity = 0
)

xgb_model

# =====================================================
# PREDICCIONS TRAIN
# =====================================================
pred_train <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = train_boost)
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_train,
  train_boost$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

# =====================================================
# PREDICCIONS TEST (sobre TRAIN intern, NO Kaggle)
# =====================================================
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(train_boost$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_in <- train_boost[idx, ]
test_in  <- train_boost[-idx, ]

pred_test_in <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = test_in)
cm_test <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_test_in,
  test_in$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

# =====================================================
# TAULA DE RESULTATS (COM LA IMATGE)
# =====================================================
resultados_xgb <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_test$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall_Sensitivity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1_Score = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_test$byClass["F1"]
  )
)

print(resultados_xgb)

# =====================================================
# PREDICCIÓ FINAL KAGGLE (IGUAL QUE EL TEU)
# =====================================================
pred_test <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = test_boost)

resultats <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited_pred = pred_test
)

write.csv(resultats, "prediccions_xgboost.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)

# Pesos (IGUAL)

table(train_boost$Exited, w)

  method = "cv",

  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

set.seed(123)

  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_boost,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = trControl,
  weights = w,
  metric = "ROC",
  verbosity = 0
)

xgb_model_w

# PREDICCIÓ TRAIN

cm_train <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_train,
  train_boost$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

# =====================================================
# PREDICCIÓ TEST INTERN (70/30)
# =====================================================
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(train_boost$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_in <- train_boost[idx, ]
test_in  <- train_boost[-idx, ]

pred_test_in <- predict(xgb_model_w, newdata = test_in)

cm_test <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_test_in,
  test_in$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

# =====================================================
resultados_xgb_w <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_test$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall_Sensitivity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1_Score = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_test$byClass["F1"]
  )
)

print(resultados_xgb_w)

# =====================================================
# PREDICCIÓ FINAL KAGGLE (IGUAL QUE EL TEU)
# =====================================================
prob_test <- predict(xgb_model_w, newdata = test_boost, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

pred_test <- factor(
  ifelse(prob_test > 0.35, "Yes", "No"),
  levels = c("No", "Yes")
)

submission <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_test
)

write.csv(submission, "submission_boost.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#un altre (BO)
```{r}

# XGBOOST BALANCEJAT + THRESHOLD ÒPTIM (KAPPA)
# + TAULA DE RESULTATS TRAIN / TEST


library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)

# =========================
# PESOS (IGUAL QUE EL TEU)
# =========================
tab <- table(train_boost$Exited)
w <- ifelse(train_boost$Exited == "Yes", tab["No"]/tab["Yes"], 1)

# =========================
# CONTROL CV (IGUAL)
# =========================
trControl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)

# =========================
# ENTRENAMENT XGBOOST (IGUAL)
# =========================
xgb_model <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_boost,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = trControl,
  weights = w,
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    nrounds = 200,
    max_depth = 4,
    eta = 0.05,
    gamma = 0,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,
    min_child_weight = 1,
    subsample = 0.8
  ),
  verbosity = 0
)

print(xgb_model)

# =========================
# THRESHOLD ÒPTIM (MAX KAPPA) - IGUAL
# =========================
prob_tr <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = train_boost, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.01)
kappa_vals <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  pred_class <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr > t, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No","Yes"))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, train_boost$Exited, positive = "Yes")
  cm$overall["Kappa"]
})

best_t <- thresholds[which.max(kappa_vals)]
cat("Best threshold (max Kappa):", best_t, "\n")

# =========================
# CONFUSION MATRIX TRAIN (threshold òptim)
# =========================
pred_tr_class <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr > best_t, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No","Yes"))

cm_train <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_tr_class,
  train_boost$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

print(cm_train)

# =========================
# CONFUSION MATRIX TEST INTERN (70/30)
# =========================
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(train_boost$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_in <- train_boost[idx, ]
test_in  <- train_boost[-idx, ]

prob_test_in <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = test_in, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
pred_test_in <- factor(ifelse(prob_test_in > best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                       levels = c("No","Yes"))

cm_test <- confusionMatrix(
  pred_test_in,
  test_in$Exited,
  positive = "Yes"
)

# =========================
# TAULA DE RESULTATS (FORMAT DEMANAT)
# =========================
resultados_xgb_kappa <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Test"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_test$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall_Sensitivity = c(
    cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_test$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1_Score = c(
    cm_train$byClass["F1"],
    cm_test$byClass["F1"]
  )
)

print(resultados_xgb_kappa)

# =========================
# PREDICCIÓ FINAL KAGGLE (IGUAL)
# =========================
prob_te <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = test_boost, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
pred_te <- factor(ifelse(prob_te > best_t, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No","Yes"))

submission <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_te
)

write.csv(submission, "submission_xgb_threshold.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

#ultim
```{r}

# XGBOOST – PIPELINE FINAL (OPTIMITZAT PER F1 / RECALL)
# + TAULA DE RESULTATS TRAIN / VALIDACIÓ


library(caret)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)

# =========================
# 1) Split TRAIN / VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
idx <- createDataPartition(train_boost$Exited, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_cv <- train_boost[idx, ]
valid_cv <- train_boost[-idx, ]

# =========================
# 2) Pesos de classe (TRAIN)
# =========================
tab <- table(train_cv$Exited)
w_train <- ifelse(train_cv$Exited == "Yes",
                  as.numeric(tab["No"] / tab["Yes"]),
                  1)

# =========================
# 3) Control CV
# =========================
trControl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# =========================
# 4) Grid XGBoost
# =========================
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(80, 120),
  max_depth = c(3, 4),
  eta = c(0.03, 0.05),
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8
)

# =========================
# 5) Entrenament XGBoost
# =========================
xgb_model <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_cv,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = trControl,
  weights = w_train,
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = xgb_grid,
  verbosity = 0
)

print(xgb_model)

# =========================
# 6) Prediccions VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
prob_val <- predict(xgb_model, valid_cv, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

# =========================
# 7) Threshold ÒPTIM (F1)
# =========================
thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.01)

f1_vals <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  pred <- factor(ifelse(prob_val > t, "Yes", "No"),
                 levels = c("No","Yes"))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, valid_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")
  cm$byClass["F1"]
})

best_t <- thresholds[which.max(f1_vals)]
cat("Best threshold (F1):", best_t, "\n")

# =========================
# 8) CONFUSION MATRIX VALIDACIÓ
# =========================
pred_val <- factor(ifelse(prob_val > best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                   levels = c("No","Yes"))

cm_val <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, valid_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")
print(cm_val)

# =========================
# 8b) CONFUSION MATRIX TRAIN
# =========================
prob_tr <- predict(xgb_model, train_cv, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

pred_tr <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr > best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))

cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr, train_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# =========================
# 9) TAULA DE RESULTATS (FORMAT FINAL)
# =========================
roc_val <- roc(valid_cv$Exited, prob_val)

resultados_xgb_f1 <- data.frame(
  Dataset     = c("Train", "Validation"),
  Accuracy    = c(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"],
                  cm_val$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Precision   = c(cm_train$byClass["Precision"],
                  cm_val$byClass["Precision"]),
  Specificity = c(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"],
                  cm_val$byClass["Specificity"]),
  Recall      = c(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                  cm_val$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  F1          = c(cm_train$byClass["F1"],
                  cm_val$byClass["F1"]),
  AUC         = c(
    as.numeric(auc(roc(train_cv$Exited, prob_tr))),
    as.numeric(auc(roc_val))
  )
)

print(resultados_xgb_f1)

# =========================
# 10) REENTRENAR AMB TOT EL TRAIN
# =========================
tab_full <- table(train_boost$Exited)
w_full <- ifelse(train_boost$Exited == "Yes",
                 as.numeric(tab_full["No"] / tab_full["Yes"]),
                 1)

final_xgb <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_boost,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = trControl,
  weights = w_full,
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = xgb_model$bestTune,
  verbosity = 0
)

# =========================
# 11) PREDICCIÓ TEST KAGGLE
# =========================
prob_te <- predict(final_xgb, test_boost, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

pred_te <- factor(ifelse(prob_te > best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))

submission <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_te
)

write.csv(submission,
          "submission_xgb_f1_opt.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

```



```{r}
# =========================================================
# XGBOOST (acadèmic) + VALIDACIÓ + MÈTRIQUES + SUBMISSION
# Optimització final orientada a Kaggle: threshold per MAX F1
# =========================================================

library(caret)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)

# ---------- 0) Checks mínims ----------
stopifnot("Exited" %in% names(train_boost))
train_boost$Exited <- factor(train_boost$Exited, levels = c("No","Yes"))

# ---------- 1) Split extern TRAIN / VALIDACIÓ ----------
idx <- createDataPartition(train_boost$Exited, p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
train_cv <- train_boost[idx, ]
valid_cv <- train_boost[-idx, ]
train_cv$Exited <- factor(train_cv$Exited, levels = c("No","Yes"))
valid_cv$Exited <- factor(valid_cv$Exited, levels = c("No","Yes"))

# ---------- 2) Pesos de classe ----------
tab <- table(train_cv$Exited)
w_train <- ifelse(train_cv$Exited == "Yes",
                  as.numeric(tab["No"]/tab["Yes"]),
                  1)

# ---------- 3) Control CV ----------
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  allowParallel = TRUE
)

# ---------- 4) Grid ----------
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(80, 120, 160),
  max_depth = c(3, 4, 5),
  eta = c(0.03, 0.05, 0.1),
  gamma = c(0, 1),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7, 0.8),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 5),
  subsample = c(0.7, 0.8)
)

# ---------- 5) Entrenament ----------
xgb_model <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_cv,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = xgb_grid,
  metric = "ROC",
  weights = w_train,
  verbosity = 0
)

print(xgb_model)

# ---------- 6) Probabilitats VALIDACIÓ ----------
prob_val <- predict(xgb_model, valid_cv, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]

# ---------- 7) Threshold per MAX F1 ----------
thresholds <- seq(0.05, 0.60, by = 0.01)

f1_vals <- sapply(thresholds, function(t){
  pred <- factor(ifelse(prob_val >= t, "Yes", "No"),
                 levels = c("No","Yes"))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, valid_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")
  as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
})

best_t <- thresholds[which.max(f1_vals)]
cat("Best threshold (max F1) =", best_t, "\n")

# ---------- 8) Mètriques VALIDACIÓ ----------
pred_val <- factor(ifelse(prob_val >= best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                   levels = c("No","Yes"))
cm_val <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, valid_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")

roc_val <- roc(valid_cv$Exited, prob_val)
auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_val))

# ---------- 8b) Mètriques TRAIN ----------
prob_tr <- predict(xgb_model, train_cv, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
pred_tr <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr >= best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))
cm_tr <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr, train_cv$Exited, positive = "Yes")

# ---------- 9) TAULA DE RESULTATS (FORMAT FINAL) ----------
resultats_xgb <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train", "Validation"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_tr$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_val$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Precision = c(
    cm_tr$byClass["Precision"],
    cm_val$byClass["Precision"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    cm_tr$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  Recall = c(
    cm_tr$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_val$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_tr$byClass["F1"],
    cm_val$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(auc(roc(train_cv$Exited, prob_tr))),
    auc_val
  )
)

print(resultats_xgb)

# ---------- (Opcional) ROC ----------
plot(roc_val, main = "ROC - Validation (XGBoost)", print.auc = TRUE)

# ---------- 10) Model final amb TOT el train ----------
tab_full <- table(train_boost$Exited)
w_full <- ifelse(train_boost$Exited == "Yes",
                 as.numeric(tab_full["No"]/tab_full["Yes"]),
                 1)

final_xgb <- train(
  Exited ~ .,
  data = train_boost,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = xgb_model$bestTune,
  metric = "ROC",
  weights = w_full,
  verbosity = 0
)

# ---------- 11) Predicció TEST Kaggle ----------
prob_te <- predict(final_xgb, test_boost, type = "prob")[,"Yes"]
pred_te <- factor(ifelse(prob_te >= best_t, "Yes", "No"),
                  levels = c("No","Yes"))

submission <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_te
)

write.csv(submission,
          "submission_xgb_f1_academic.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ---------- Control distribució ----------
print(table(pred_te))
```

#model
```{r}
# ============================================================
# XGBOOST FINAL COMPACTE (acadèmic)
# CV early stopping + validació 70/30
# threshold MAX F1 + TAULA TRAIN / TEST + Kaggle
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(Matrix)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)

set.seed(2025)

# =========================
# 0) Llegir dades i tipus
# =========================
dades <- read.csv2("dades_imputades.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
dades$Balance   <- as.numeric(dades$Balance)
dades$Geography <- factor(dades$Geography)
dades$Gender    <- factor(dades$Gender)

# =========================
# 1) Split train / test Kaggle
# =========================
df_tr <- dades %>% filter(Group == "train")
df_te <- dades %>% filter(Group == "test")

vars_x <- c("Geography","Balance","Age","IsActiveMember",
            "NumOfProducts","NetPromoterScore","Gender")

# Target
y_fac <- factor(
  ifelse(as.character(df_tr$Exited) %in% c("1","Yes","TRUE","yes",1),
         "Yes","No"),
  levels = c("No","Yes")
)
y <- ifelse(y_fac == "Yes", 1, 0)

# =========================
# 2) Dummies + escalat (fit només amb train)
# =========================
dmy <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_tr[, vars_x], fullRank = TRUE)
X_tr <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_tr[, vars_x]))
X_te <- as.data.frame(predict(dmy, df_te[, vars_x]))
X_te <- X_te[, colnames(X_tr), drop = FALSE]

pp <- preProcess(X_tr, method = c("center","scale"))
X_tr <- predict(pp, X_tr)
X_te <- predict(pp, X_te)

# NZV
nzv <- nearZeroVar(X_tr)
if (length(nzv) > 0) {
  X_tr <- X_tr[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
  X_te <- X_te[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
}

# NA / Inf → mediana train
X_tr[!is.finite(as.matrix(X_tr))] <- NA
X_te[!is.finite(as.matrix(X_te))] <- NA
meds <- sapply(X_tr, median, na.rm = TRUE)
for (v in names(X_tr)) {
  X_tr[[v]][is.na(X_tr[[v]])] <- meds[[v]]
  X_te[[v]][is.na(X_te[[v]])] <- meds[[v]]
}

Xtr_m <- Matrix(as.matrix(X_tr), sparse = TRUE)
Xte_m <- Matrix(as.matrix(X_te), sparse = TRUE)

# =========================
# 3) Pesos (desbalanceig)
# =========================
scale_pos_weight <- sum(y == 0) / sum(y == 1)

params <- list(
  booster = "gbtree",
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  eta = 0.08,
  max_depth = 5,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.85,
  colsample_bytree = 0.85,
  gamma = 0,
  scale_pos_weight = scale_pos_weight
)

# =========================
# 4) CV + early stopping
# =========================
dtrain_all <- xgb.DMatrix(Xtr_m, label = y)

cv <- xgb.cv(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_all,
  nrounds = 2000,
  nfold = 5,
  stratified = TRUE,
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,
  verbose = 0
)

best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration

# =========================
# 5) Validació 70/30 (TRAIN / TEST interns)
# =========================
set.seed(123)
idx <- createDataPartition(y_fac, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

X_in  <- Matrix(as.matrix(X_tr[idx, ]),  sparse = TRUE)
X_val <- Matrix(as.matrix(X_tr[-idx, ]), sparse = TRUE)
y_in  <- y[idx]
y_val <- y[-idx]

d_in  <- xgb.DMatrix(X_in,  label = y_in)
d_val <- xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label = y_val)

xgb_in <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = d_in,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  verbose = 0
)

# =========================
# 6) PREDICCIONS TRAIN / TEST
# =========================
prob_train <- predict(xgb_in, d_in)
prob_testv <- predict(xgb_in, d_val)

y_train_fac <- factor(ifelse(y_in == 1,"Yes","No"), levels=c("No","Yes"))
y_test_fac  <- factor(ifelse(y_val== 1,"Yes","No"), levels=c("No","Yes"))

# =========================
# 7) Threshold òptim (MAX F1 sobre TEST)
# =========================
thresholds <- seq(0.15, 0.60, by = 0.01)
f1_vals <- sapply(thresholds, function(t){
  pred <- factor(ifelse(prob_testv >= t,"Yes","No"), levels=c("No","Yes"))
  confusionMatrix(pred, y_test_fac, positive="Yes")$byClass["F1"]
})
best_t <- thresholds[which.max(f1_vals)]
cat("Threshold òptim (MAX F1):", best_t, "\n")

# =========================
# 8) Confusion matrices
# =========================
pred_train <- factor(ifelse(prob_train >= best_t,"Yes","No"), levels=c("No","Yes"))
pred_test  <- factor(ifelse(prob_testv >= best_t,"Yes","No"), levels=c("No","Yes"))

cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, y_train_fac, positive="Yes")
cm_test  <- confusionMatrix(pred_test,  y_test_fac,  positive="Yes")

# ROC + AUC (TEST)
roc_test <- roc(y_test_fac, prob_testv, levels=c("No","Yes"))
auc_test <- as.numeric(auc(roc_test))

# =========================
# 9) TAULA FINAL TRAIN / TEST
# =========================
resultats_xgb <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Train","Test"),
  Accuracy = c(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"], cm_test$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Precision = c(cm_train$byClass["Precision"], cm_test$byClass["Precision"]),
  Recall = c(cm_train$byClass["Recall"], cm_test$byClass["Recall"]),
  F1 = c(cm_train$byClass["F1"], cm_test$byClass["F1"]),
  Kappa = c(cm_train$overall["Kappa"], cm_test$overall["Kappa"]),
  AUC = c(NA, auc_test)
)

print(resultats_xgb)

# =========================
# 10) Model FINAL (TOT el train) + Kaggle
# =========================
xgb_final <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain_all,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  verbose = 0
)

prob_kaggle <- predict(xgb_final, xgb.DMatrix(Xte_m))
pred_kaggle <- ifelse(prob_kaggle >= best_t,"Yes","No")

submission <- data.frame(
  ID = df_te$ID,
  Exited = pred_kaggle
)

write.csv(submission,
          "xgboost_submission_f1_opt.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Submissió creada amb threshold =", best_t, "\n")

```
